sources.name: WebCodecs API
sources.summary: MDN documents browser audio/video encode/decode APIs and Dedicated Worker availability; Phase 44D records availability only and does not process media.

sources.name: WebGPU API
sources.summary: MDN documents WebGPU as limited availability; Phase 44D treats presence as unapproved planning metadata only.

sources.name: GPU.requestAdapter
sources.summary: MDN marks requestAdapter as secure-context dependent and limited availability; Phase 44D does not persist adapter vendor/device details.

sources.name: SharedArrayBuffer
sources.summary: MDN documents cross-origin isolation requirements for shared memory; Phase 44D warns when isolation is missing.

sources.name: Navigator.hardwareConcurrency
sources.summary: MDN documents logical processor count; Phase 44D buckets the value and never stores exact values.

sources.name: Navigator.deviceMemory
sources.summary: MDN documents approximate memory; Phase 44D buckets the value and treats absence as unknown.

sources.name: StorageManager.estimate
sources.summary: MDN documents approximate usage/quota estimates; Phase 44D buckets estimates and does not request persistence.

sources.name: OffscreenCanvas
sources.summary: MDN documents off-main-thread canvas capability; Phase 44D records availability only.

sources.name: Network Information API
sources.summary: MDN documents coarse connection information with limited support; Phase 44D records optional coarse values only and performs no speed test.
